**Finding submitted: deviation (NOSOLICIT).**

- **Responsive locations:** § 12.4 (p0045) is the only non-solicit/no-hire provision in the document (searches for "solicit", "employee", non-solicitation carve-outs returned nothing else). § 12.4 as numbered also appears at p0046, but that is a non-compete covenant, governed by a different rule and not flagged here.
- **Why it fails fallback:** one-sided on Customer, express no-hire ("hire, or employ"), 24 months post-term, all Vendor employees rather than personnel involved in the Services, and no general-advertising/unsolicited-approach carve-out — "regardless of how the employee applies" affirmatively defeats one. That is walk-away territory.
- **Internal conflict:** § 12.3 has Vendor acknowledge that Customer has made "no ... no-hire commitment", which § 12.4 contradicts.
- **Cure:** a single in-place edit removing the restriction on Customer, meeting the sole preferred element and leaving § 12.3 consistent; the mutual 12-month involved-personnel fallback is offered in the comment.
